teams.detail: Lost to Blue Jays 2-0 Friday at T-Mobile Park; 45-44, 2nd in the AL West. Hosting Toronto again today, 4:10 PM PT — in progress at brief time.
Coming off 60-22 season (1st in East), lost East semis to Cleveland. Added G Isaiah Joe via trade with OKC. Summer League opens July 9 vs. 76ers, headlined by No. 17 pick Ebuka Okorie.
Training camp opens July 25 in Renton. Charbonnet (ACL) progressing well ahead of late-July checkup. Two ESPY nominations, including Jaxon Smith-Njigba for Best NFL Player.
RB Jordan Washington carted off in spring practice; Fisch targets late-July return. Huskies placed 7 players on Athlon's Preseason All-Big Ten teams.
Danny Sprinkle rebuilding via the portal after losing Zoom Diallo, adding transfers from Texas Tech, San Francisco and Gonzaga plus 2026 signee Lattimore Ford.
